theme.mood: Eerie 90s anime computer interface, Serial Experiments Lain (Copland OS Navi), CRT cyber-dystopia

rules: No rounded sans-serifs. Strictly terminal, pixel, and monospaced typography.
Uppercase for all module titles and button labels.
Avoid muddy grays. Use dark navy tints for neutrals.
All panels must have a 1px solid border with a cyan drop-shadow to simulate CRT phosphor bleed.

layout_and_spacing.desktop: A fixed viewport layout (h-screen w-screen overflow-hidden) to simulate a true desktop OS. Do not use standard vertical scrolling for the whole page. Scroll inside panels only.
layout_and_spacing.grid: CSS Grid / Bento-box style mimicking floating windows. grid-cols-12 with dense packing.
layout_and_spacing.panels: Each panel needs a thick top 'chrome' bar (like a retro OS window header) displaying the module name, e.g., '[ SISTEMA_ACTIVO ]'.
layout_and_spacing.spacing: Tight padding inside terminal areas (p-2). Moderate padding for settings (p-4).

css_effects_and_animations.crt_scanlines: Add a global ::before overlay with a repeating linear-gradient (transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 50%) at background-size: 100% 4px. Use pointer-events-none.
css_effects_and_animations.flicker: Subtle opacity animation on the entire container to simulate an unstable CRT connection.
css_effects_and_animations.glow: Box-shadows inside and outside window panels.
css_effects_and_animations.vhs_distortion: Applied to the Avatar Video Panel specifically, combining CSS blur and the provided Unsplash glitch textures.

components.top_system_bar: Fixed at the top. Displays OS version (Navi v7.0), current time (timestamps), user (admin), network status.
components.terminal_console: The main focus. Darkest background (#000). Contains tabs (CHAT, COMPARTIR, COMANDOS). Timestamp on every line. Blinking cursor block. Bright green or cyan text.
components.avatar_video_panel: Square aspect ratio. Uses the vhs_glitch image as an overlay. Labels like 'PLAY', 'CH02', 'SIGNAL', 'CONNECTED' overlayed in pure white or bright orange. The content behind the glitch should be eerie/abstract.
components.audio_waveform: Visualizer mimicking audio frequencies. Can be a series of divs animating their heights, colored in neon cyan/purple gradients.
components.module_status: 6 grid blocks. Shows CPU/RAM bars (made of ASCII blocks like ▓▓▓▓░░), status (ONLINE/OFFLINE), last ping.
components.task_queue: A list of pending/running/completed tasks. Prefix with status glyphs (e.g. [>] running, [*] pending).
components.logs_viewer: Fast-moving terminal window. Auto-scrolling. Red text for errors, yellow for security. Buttons for filtering.
components.prompt_templates: Cards designed like retro floppy disks or data-shards. Hover effect adds a purple glow.
components.tools_agents: Table layout. Columns: Habilitado, Modo, Riesgo (Risk). Risk highlights in Orange/Red.
components.secrets_panel: Input fields with masked characters (****). Neon borders on focus. 'Desbloquear' (Unlock) button.
components.recovery_settings: Toggles for EN/ES/JA, Theme (CRT/Clean), Scanline Intensity. Use brutalist HTML-like checkboxes or toggles.
components.security_audit: Chart or timeline of security events.
components.status_footer: Fixed at bottom. Running ticker of background processes and connection strength.

media_and_icons.icons_strategy: Use Phosphor Icons (sharp/duotone) or pure ASCII characters ([, ], >, #, *). Avoid overly modern rounded icons.

image_urls.description: Abstract colorful glitch art, use for Avatar video panel overlay with mix-blend-mode: overlay.
Abstract pink/brown glitch art, use for alternative noise/distortion effect.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install VT323 and Space Mono from Google Fonts in index.html.
Add custom .crt utility in index.css for the global scanline effect.
Implement the layout as a full-viewport (h-screen w-screen) Dashboard containing floating, bordered panels.
Ensure UI language defaults to Spanish (e.g., 'COMANDOS', 'SISTEMA', 'CONECTADO').
For the Avatar panel, use absolute positioning to overlay the VHS image with mix-blend-screen or opacity-30.
Include data-testid attributes on all buttons, tabs, and form elements.
Do not use Shadcn card rounded corners; override rounded components to use sharp edges (rounded-none).
